classification: TEST/EVIDENCE GAP with source-proven unsafe idleness assumption; not a newly confirmed production locale defect
disposition: HOLD acceptance of the two-write-only patch. The two explicit selection writes are corrected, but an equivalent internal-effect notification race and an unchanged sibling custom test remain. Recommend public ComposeUiTest scene idleness for both.

evidence.original_linux: reviews/ci-run-34143924756-evidence/failing-junit-01; original ProvideAppLanguageDesktopTest failed Arabic -> System expected Leave but retained Arabic (assertion line89). Raw failure does not establish an exact thread interleaving.
evidence.partial_patch_execution: evidence/linux-ui-fixtures-green-01 ran the provider test once, passed in0.005 seconds. This pass is real but not proof that the independent residual race is removed.

reachable_primary_race: A previous real Compose UI fixture initializes the JVM-wide GlobalSnapshotManager (BaseComposeScene125–127), which retains an external UI dispatcher consumer (GlobalSnapshotManager40–53). Custom UnitApplier/Recomposer fixture does not own/drain that dispatcher.

A test global selectedLanguage write wakes the notifier. advanceGlobalSnapshot2006–2025 captures and clears modified global state under lock, then invokes observers outside that lock. A scheduling interruption can occur between capture and invocation.

Meanwhile the test calls sendApplyNotifications687–689; global changes are already consumed so it does not join in-flight callbacks. Its coroutine-test runCurrent then has no queued recomposition, allowing a stale immediate assertion.

RegisterApplyObserver1144–1163 only queues recomposition after it receives the callback. Later callback delivery updates the app normally. This is a test synchronization path, not evidence of permanently stale production state.
what_the_two_write_patch_fixes: withMutableSnapshot452–466 creates an isolated mutable snapshot and invokes apply().check() before returning.

MutableSnapshot.apply816–905 invokes the apply observers synchronously for its modified records before returning Success. Its isolation does not merge global write observers (GlobalSnapshot1551–1574).
Therefore the replacement synchronously notifies the custom recomposer about both explicit selectedLanguage writes; that correction is not itself rejected.
remaining_internal_effect_path: Desktop PlatformAppLocale21–27 writes appliedLanguageTag from DisposableEffect, after setting/restoring the JVM default. This is distinct from the test selectedLanguage field.

Recomposer applies changes715–717 inside TransparentObserverMutableSnapshot825–850. That transparent snapshot introduces observers, not isolation: Snapshot1678–1743 forwards modified records to the global parent. DisposableEffectImpl84–85 runs its body onRemembered.

The resulting global appliedLanguageTag write can be captured by the external notifier before the custom recomposer's notifyObjectsInitialized764. That API advances the global snapshot again (Snapshot1577–1579) but does not wait for a notification already captured by another thread.

Raw runCurrent, Recomposer.hasPendingWork1573–1583 and Recomposer.awaitIdle1606–1607 do not check Snapshot.isApplyObserverNotificationPending. The second recompose that updates activeTag/resources can still arrive after the test asserts.

No deterministic runtime witness for this residual interleaving was executed by the reviewer. The reachability proof is from the pinned implementation; do not describe a locally observed intermittent failure that was not run.
sibling_path: RtlFormattingTest80–141 uses the same custom recomposer;122–125 mutates JVM locale and global selection then sendApplyNotifications/runCurrent. It has the primary selection-write race even without PlatformAppLocale. A focused correction should cover it too.
counter_evidence: Desktop resource loading is synchronous remember/runBlocking in resources ResourceState.blocking.kt1–66; this is not evidence of asynchronous resource I/O lag.
LocalLayoutDirection is a static composition local, so do not assume child skipping alone proves a production stale-resource defect.
Recomposer does flush global changes via notifyObjectsInitialized; the defect hypothesis accounts for it and only concerns already-in-flight observer delivery.
Public Skiko test API explicitly checks the in-flight notification counter; a custom sleep/retry/assertion weakening or production state mutation is unnecessary.
recommended_minimal_correction: Use the real public ComposeUiTest scene for both resource tests; do not construct an independent UnitApplier/Recomposer/ImmediateFrameClock. Keep mainClock.autoAdvance=true.

Perform test-owned Locale and selectedLanguage writes together on runOnIdle/UI thread, then invoke waitForIdle or the next runOnIdle before assertions. runOnIdle waits before its callback, not after (382–385). Never call blocking waitForIdle from inside the UI-thread callback.

isIdle336–350 checks pending measure/layout, global pending snapshot changes, Snapshot.isApplyObserverNotificationPending, scene invalidations and registered idle resources. The autoAdvance=false branch intentionally bypasses snapshot/recomposer idle342–344 and is unsuitable here.

Assert initial loading through an ordered SideEffect observation ledger (first Loading before any Content; loading observation has empty content/no remembered content state). Public setContent automatically waits off the UI thread410–422, so observing only the final phase would weaken initial-order coverage.

Retain real English/Arabic/System strings and matching direction, exact JVM System restoration, a stable remembered object, zero intermediate disposals, and exact one final disposal. Do not key-remount content to force resource reload.
Use a small actual framebuffer and explicit60-second test deadline if selecting runSkikoComposeUiTest; its default timeout is infinite. Keep assertion reads on the UI-thread/idle barrier.

Restore the original process Locale in an unconditional outer finally; do not put restoration after a potentially failing assertion or disposal step. Allow the public scene owner to close/cancel its own runtime.

Root should implement; reviewer supplies source reasoning only, not concrete patch code. Then independently review the resulting complete diff and the actual discovered executed test IDs, including sibling and surrounding suite order.

Run with preceding real Compose UI fixtures or whole relevant modules to initialize the persistent global manager and expose the original cross-fixture dependency.

Optionally retain an isolated deliberately delayed apply-observer witness if a deterministic regression mechanism is desired, but it must own any thread/latches, never block an existing UI notifier, and must not enter shipping source.
